Directions: Read and study the sources about the explorations of Henry Hudson. Then use the three sources and your knowledge of social studies to answer each question that follows.
Title: Source 1: Voyages of Henry Hudson (1609-1611)
Content: Henry Hudson was an English explorer sent to North America in `text(1609)` by Dutch traders to find a `text(northwest)` passage to China. He failed at that, but succeeded at finding and claiming new areas for Dutch colonization. He returned the following `text(year)`, paid by English investors.
